protocol.same_workload: R39 512PP+200TG, stream1, context1024, Q8KV, mmap, no warmup
protocol.intervention: existing R37 LLAMA_MOE_INPUT_CONTROL modes on same WORK frozen engine
protocol.observer_gate: For each intervention observer OFF/ON full raw logits byte-exact, finite/nonzero; all-on/repeat full captures byte-exact. Control equals R39. No fidelity thresholds relaxed.
protocol.capture: 600 completed CPU projection records per captured process, Q8_K work bytes and original F32 inputs, ids, outputs; allow different gate/up inputs only for explicit interventions
protocol.comparison: For every projection and decode step compare F32 input, IDs, Q8_K block scales/quants/sums and projection output. First nonzero divergence and direct quantization of pre-downstream inputs reported.
protocol.scope: CPU roundtrip cause isolation, does not certify CPU/GPU placement or quality
